```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)

# Set chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  message = FALSE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  fig.width = 10, 
  fig.height = 6
)
```

## Data Loading and Cleaning

```{r data-loading}
# Read Excel file
Tourist_A <- read_excel("Tourist accomodation From 2007.xlsx",
                        sheet = "Tourist accomodation From 2007")

# Clean and transform the data
Tourist_A_clean <- Tourist_A %>%
  select(-H01, -H02, -H03, -H15, -H16, -H25, -`_LABEL_`) %>%
  separate(H04, into = c("IncomeType", "AccommodationType"), sep = " - ", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(
    IncomeType = trimws(IncomeType),
    AccommodationType = trimws(AccommodationType),
    Currency = ifelse(str_detect(H17, "R\\s?million|Rands"), 
                     str_extract(H17, "R\\s?million|Rands"), NA),
    Rate = ifelse(str_detect(H17, "Percentage|%"), "Percentage", NA),
    NumberCount = ifelse(str_detect(H17, "Thousand"), "Thousand", NA)
  ) %>%
  select(-H17)

# Pivot to long format
monthly_cols <- grep("^MO\\d{6}$", names(Tourist_A_clean), value = TRUE)

Tourist_A_long <- Tourist_A_clean %>%
  select(IncomeType, AccommodationType, Currency, Rate, NumberCount, all_of(monthly_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("MO"), names_to = "MonthYear", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    Month = substr(MonthYear, 3, 4),
    Year = substr(MonthYear, 5, 8),
    TimePeriod = as.Date(paste0(Year, "-", Month, "-01")),
    Value = as.numeric(Value)
  ) %>%
  select(-MonthYear, -Month, -Year)

# Create final cleaned dataset
Tourist_A_long_clean <- Tourist_A_long %>%
  mutate(
    CurrencyValue = ifelse(!is.na(Currency), Value, 0),
    PercentageValue = ifelse(!is.na(Rate), Value, 0),
    NumberOfRooms = ifelse(!is.na(NumberCount), Value, 0),
    NumberType = coalesce(Currency, Rate, NumberCount)
  ) %>%
  select(IncomeType, AccommodationType, NumberType, TimePeriod,
         CurrencyValue, PercentageValue, NumberOfRooms)

# Display last 10 rows of cleaned data
kable(tail(Tourist_A_long_clean, 10), 
      caption = "Cleaned Tourist Accommodation Data (Last 10 Rows)")
```

## Currency Value Trends by Accommodation Type

```{r currency-trends}
# Calculate mean currency values by time period and accommodation type
currency_trends <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  group_by(TimePeriod, AccommodationType) %>%
  summarise(Mean_CurrencyValue = mean(CurrencyValue, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Create trend visualization
ggplot(currency_trends, aes(x = TimePeriod, y = Mean_CurrencyValue, color = AccommodationType)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Currency Value by Accommodation Type (2007-2024)",
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Mean Currency Value (R Million)", 
    color = "Accommodation Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Occupancy Rate Analysis

```{r occupancy-analysis}
# Filter occupancy rate data for different accommodation types
AccommodationType_Hotel <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  filter(
    str_to_lower(AccommodationType) == "hotels", 
    str_to_lower(IncomeType) == "occupancy rate", 
    PercentageValue > 0
  )

AccommodationType_CaravanParks <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  filter(
    str_to_lower(AccommodationType) == "caravan parks and camping sites", 
    str_to_lower(IncomeType) == "occupancy rate", 
    PercentageValue > 0
  )

AccommodationType_GuestHouses <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  filter(
    str_to_lower(AccommodationType) == "guest houses and guest farms", 
    str_to_lower(IncomeType) == "occupancy rate", 
    PercentageValue > 0
  )

AccommodationType_Other <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  filter(
    str_to_lower(AccommodationType) == "other accommodation", 
    str_to_lower(IncomeType) == "occupancy rate", 
    PercentageValue > 0
  )

AccommodationType_TotalIndustry <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  filter(
    str_to_lower(AccommodationType) == "total industry", 
    str_to_lower(IncomeType) == "occupancy rate", 
    PercentageValue > 0
  )

# Create list of accommodation types
accom_list <- list(
  "Hotels" = AccommodationType_Hotel,
  "Caravan Parks & Camping Sites" = AccommodationType_CaravanParks,
  "Guest Houses & Guest Farms" = AccommodationType_GuestHouses,
  "Other Accommodation" = AccommodationType_Other,
  "Total Industry" = AccommodationType_TotalIndustry
)

# Calculate mean occupancy rates
mean_occupancy <- lapply(names(accom_list), function(name) {
  data <- accom_list[[name]]
  mean_val <- if(nrow(data) > 0) mean(data$PercentageValue, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  data.frame(Accommodation_Type = name, Mean_Occupancy = mean_val)
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Create horizontal bar chart
ggplot(mean_occupancy, aes(x = reorder(Accommodation_Type, Mean_Occupancy),
                           y = Mean_Occupancy, fill = Mean_Occupancy)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Mean_Occupancy, 1)), hjust = -0.1, size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#AED6F1", high = "#21618C") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Occupancy Rate by Accommodation Type",
    x = "", 
    y = "Mean Occupancy Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Hotel Occupancy Forecasting using SARIMA

```{r prepare-data}
# Prepare time series data for hotels
AccommodationType_Hotel <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  filter(AccommodationType == "hotels",
         IncomeType == "occupancy rate",
         PercentageValue > 0) %>%
  arrange(TimePeriod)

cat("Hotel occupancy data summary:\n")
cat("Number of observations:", nrow(AccommodationType_Hotel), "\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(AccommodationType_Hotel$TimePeriod)), "to", 
    as.character(max(AccommodationType_Hotel$TimePeriod)), "\n")
cat("Mean occupancy rate:", round(mean(AccommodationType_Hotel$PercentageValue, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")

# Check if we have enough data for time series analysis
if(nrow(AccommodationType_Hotel) > 12) {
  start_year <- year(min(AccommodationType_Hotel$TimePeriod))
  start_month <- month(min(AccommodationType_Hotel$TimePeriod))
  
  time_series_data <- ts(AccommodationType_Hotel$PercentageValue,
                         start = c(start_year, start_month),
                         frequency = 12)
  cat("Time series created successfully.\n")
} else {
  cat("Warning: Insufficient data for time series analysis. Need at least 12 months of data.\n")
  time_series_data <- NULL
}
```

```{r train-test-split}
# Split into train/test only if we have enough data
if(!is.null(time_series_data) && length(time_series_data) > 12) {
  train_length <- round(length(time_series_data) * 0.8)
  train_ts <- window(time_series_data, end = time(time_series_data)[train_length])
  test_ts <- window(time_series_data, start = time(time_series_data)[train_length + 1])
  
  cat("Training set size:", length(train_ts), "months\n")
  cat("Testing set size:", length(test_ts), "months\n")
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for train-test split.\n")
  train_ts <- NULL
  test_ts <- NULL
}
```

```{r model-fitting}
# Initialize variables to avoid reference errors
arima_model <- NULL
sarima_model <- NULL
fit_SARIMA <- NULL
forecast_SARIMA <- NULL

# Fit models only if we have sufficient data
if(!is.null(train_ts) && length(train_ts) > 12) {
  # Fit ARIMA and SARIMA models
  cat("Fitting ARIMA model...\n")
  arima_model <- tryCatch({
    auto.arima(train_ts, seasonal = FALSE, stepwise = TRUE, approximation = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error fitting ARIMA model:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  cat("Fitting SARIMA model...\n")
  sarima_model <- tryCatch({
    auto.arima(train_ts, seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = TRUE, approximation = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error fitting SARIMA model:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  if(!is.null(arima_model) && !is.null(test_ts)) {
    h <- length(test_ts)
    arima_forecast <- forecast(arima_model, h = h)
    sarima_forecast <- forecast(sarima_model, h = h)
  }
  
  # Fit full SARIMA for 5-year forecast
  cat("Fitting full SARIMA model for forecasting...\n")
  fit_SARIMA <- tryCatch({
    auto.arima(time_series_data, seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = TRUE, approximation = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error fitting full SARIMA model:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  if(!is.null(fit_SARIMA)) {
    forecast_SARIMA <- forecast(fit_SARIMA, h = 60)
    cat("Forecast successfully generated.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Cannot fit models due to insufficient data.\n")
  cat("Training data length:", if(!is.null(train_ts)) length(train_ts) else "NULL", "\n")
}
```

```{r model-summary}
# Display model summaries if models were fitted
if(!is.null(arima_model)) {
  cat("=== ARIMA Model Summary ===\n")
  print(summary(arima_model))
  
  cat("\n=== SARIMA Model Summary ===\n")
  print(summary(sarima_model))
  
  cat("\n=== Full SARIMA Model (5-year forecast) ===\n")
  print(summary(fit_SARIMA))
} else {
  cat("No models to display - insufficient data.\n")
}
```

```{r train-test-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Create train-test plot if data is available
if(!is.null(time_series_data) && !is.null(train_ts)) {
  # Create data frame for ggplot
  ts_data_df <- data.frame(
    Time = as.Date(as.yearmon(time(time_series_data))),
    Actual = as.numeric(time_series_data),
    Type = ifelse(as.yearmon(time(time_series_data)) <= as.yearmon(time(train_ts)[length(train_ts)]), 
                  "Train", "Test")
  )
  
  ggplot(ts_data_df, aes(x = Time, y = Actual, color = Type)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Train" = "blue", "Test" = "magenta")) +
    labs(title = "Train and Test Data - Hotel Occupancy Rates",
         y = "Occupancy Rate (%)", 
         x = "Year",
         color = "Data Type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  cat("Cannot create train-test plot - insufficient data.\n")
}
```

```{r test-forecast-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Create test vs forecast plot if models were fitted
if(!is.null(test_ts) && !is.null(arima_model)) {
  # Prepare data for test vs forecast comparison
  test_dates <- as.Date(as.yearmon(time(test_ts)))
  comparison_df <- data.frame(
    Date = test_dates,
    Actual = as.numeric(test_ts),
    ARIMA_Forecast = as.numeric(arima_forecast$mean),
    SARIMA_Forecast = as.numeric(sarima_forecast$mean)
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Actual, ARIMA_Forecast, SARIMA_Forecast), 
                 names_to = "Series", values_to = "Value")
  
  ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = Date, y = Value, color = Series, linetype = Series)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black", 
                                 "ARIMA_Forecast" = "green", 
                                 "SARIMA_Forecast" = "orange")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Actual" = "solid", 
                                    "ARIMA_Forecast" = "dashed", 
                                    "SARIMA_Forecast" = "dotted")) +
    labs(title = "Test Data vs Forecast Models - Hotel Occupancy Rates",
         y = "Occupancy Rate (%)", 
         x = "Year",
         color = "Series",
         linetype = "Series") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  cat("Cannot create test-forecast plot - insufficient data or models not fitted.\n")
}
```

```{r full-forecast-plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
# Create full forecast plot if SARIMA model was fitted
if(exists("forecast_SARIMA") && !is.null(forecast_SARIMA) && nrow(AccommodationType_Hotel) > 0) {
  # Determine y-axis limits
  y_min <- min(c(time_series_data, forecast_SARIMA$lower), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(c(time_series_data, forecast_SARIMA$upper), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Prepare data for ggplot full 5-year forecast
  forecast_df <- data.frame(
    Date = seq(from = as.Date(max(AccommodationType_Hotel$TimePeriod)) %m+% months(1),
               by = "month", length.out = 60),
    Forecast = forecast_SARIMA$mean,
    Lower80 = forecast_SARIMA$lower[,1],
    Upper80 = forecast_SARIMA$upper[,1],
    Lower95 = forecast_SARIMA$lower[,2],
    Upper95 = forecast_SARIMA$upper[,2]
  )
  
  actual_df <- data.frame(
    Date = AccommodationType_Hotel$TimePeriod,
    Actual = AccommodationType_Hotel$PercentageValue
  )
  
  # Create the forecast plot
  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = actual_df, aes(x = Date, y = Actual, color = "Actual Data"), size = 1) +
    geom_line(data = forecast_df, aes(x = Date, y = Forecast, color = "SARIMA Forecast"), size = 1) +
    geom_ribbon(data = forecast_df, aes(x = Date, ymin = Lower95, ymax = Upper95, fill = "95% CI"), 
                alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(data = forecast_df, aes(x = Date, ymin = Lower80, ymax = Upper80, fill = "80% CI"), 
                alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data", 
                       values = c("Actual Data" = "black", "SARIMA Forecast" = "blue")) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Confidence Intervals",
                      values = c("95% CI" = "lightgray", "80% CI" = "lightblue")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max)) +
    labs(title = "SARIMA Forecast: Hotel Occupancy Rates (Next 5 Years)", 
         x = "Year", 
         y = "Occupancy Rate (%)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "horizontal",
          axis.text = element_text(size = 10))
} else {
  cat("Cannot create forecast plot - SARIMA model not fitted or insufficient data.\n")
  cat("Available objects:\n")
  cat("forecast_SARIMA exists:", exists("forecast_SARIMA"), "\n")
  if(exists("forecast_SARIMA")) cat("forecast_SARIMA is null:", is.null(forecast_SARIMA), "\n")
  cat("Hotel data rows:", nrow(AccommodationType_Hotel), "\n")
}
```

```{r accuracy-metrics}
# Calculate accuracy metrics if models were fitted
if(!is.null(arima_model) && !is.null(test_ts)) {
  arima_accuracy <- accuracy(arima_forecast, test_ts)
  sarima_accuracy <- accuracy(sarima_forecast, test_ts)
  
  cat("ARIMA Model Accuracy on Test Set:\n")
  print(arima_accuracy)
  
  cat("\nSARIMA Model Accuracy on Test Set:\n")
  print(sarima_accuracy)
  
  # Create a comparison table
  accuracy_comparison <- data.frame(
    Model = c("ARIMA", "SARIMA"),
    RMSE = c(arima_accuracy[2, "RMSE"], sarima_accuracy[2, "RMSE"]),
    MAE = c(arima_accuracy[2, "MAE"], sarima_accuracy[2, "MAE"]),
    MAPE = c(arima_accuracy[2, "MAPE"], sarima_accuracy[2, "MAPE"])
  )
  
  cat("\nModel Comparison (Lower values are better):\n")
  print(accuracy_comparison)
} else {
  cat("Cannot calculate accuracy metrics - models not fitted or insufficient test data.\n")
}
```

```{r forecast-summary}
# Display forecast summary if forecast was generated
if(exists("forecast_SARIMA") && !is.null(forecast_SARIMA)) {
  forecast_df <- data.frame(
    Date = seq(from = as.Date(max(AccommodationType_Hotel$TimePeriod)) %m+% months(1),
               by = "month", length.out = 60),
    Forecast = forecast_SARIMA$mean,
    Lower80 = forecast_SARIMA$lower[,1],
    Upper80 = forecast_SARIMA$upper[,1]
  )
  
  cat("=== 5-Year Forecast Summary ===\n")
  cat("Forecast period:", as.character(forecast_df$Date[1]), "to", 
      as.character(forecast_df$Date[60]), "\n")
  cat("Mean forecasted occupancy:", round(mean(forecast_df$Forecast), 2), "%\n")
  cat("Minimum forecasted occupancy:", round(min(forecast_df$Forecast), 2), "%\n")
  cat("Maximum forecasted occupancy:", round(max(forecast_df$Forecast), 2), "%\n")
  
  # Show first 12 months of forecast
  cat("\nFirst 12 months of forecast:\n")
  forecast_first_year <- data.frame(
    Month = format(forecast_df$Date[1:12], "%b %Y"),
    Forecast = round(forecast_df$Forecast[1:12], 2),
    Lower_80 = round(forecast_df$Lower80[1:12], 2),
    Upper_80 = round(forecast_df$Upper80[1:12], 2)
  )
  print(forecast_first_year)
} else {
  cat("No forecast available to summarize.\n")
  cat("This is likely because:\n")
  cat("- Insufficient hotel occupancy data was found\n")
  cat("- The SARIMA model could not be fitted\n")
  cat("- There were issues with the time series data\n\n")
  
  # Debug information
  cat("Debug information:\n")
  cat("Hotel data rows:", nrow(AccommodationType_Hotel), "\n")
  if(exists("time_series_data")) {
    cat("Time series data exists:", !is.null(time_series_data), "\n")
    if(!is.null(time_series_data)) {
      cat("Time series length:", length(time_series_data), "\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Time series data not created\n")
  }
}
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r summary-stats}
# Display summary statistics for key metrics
summary_stats <- Tourist_A_long_clean %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Records = n(),
    Unique_Accommodation_Types = n_distinct(AccommodationType),
    Date_Range = paste(min(TimePeriod), "to", max(TimePeriod)),
    Mean_Currency_Value = mean(CurrencyValue[CurrencyValue > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Occupancy_Rate = mean(PercentageValue[PercentageValue > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  )

kable(summary_stats, caption = "Dataset Summary Statistics")
```
